reasons: every declared check ran clean; the release still names 2 open item(s) to close outside this toolkit

device_parameters.reason: the assumed figures this board leans on (regulator dropout beyond its 1 mA characterisation, DC-bias fractions) enter the claim set as BOUNDS with stated assumptions, never as exact knowledge; the toolkit-shaped records land when an exact claim needs one demoted

orientation.reason: no part on this board needs a rotation correction; the CPL ships library angles and the fabrication order review checks the preview

timing.reason: no timing interfaces are declared; the board's buses are DC control lines with no budget to state

open_items.statement: the assembled board delivers the rated 2.1 A at 5 V across the usable cell range; no conductor-sizing basis is frozen in this repository, so the copper's share is measured, not derived
